description: NIST's FTC-08 (AP203, solid #27): the edge at (59.69, 30.48, 44.831) filleted alone at r 0.2721, the census's radius for the part. Its chain takes the edges at (52.07, 39.05, 44.831) and (67.31, 39.69, 44.831) as well, and the output fails the checker at L2: two faces' loops have pcurves that jump 3.1e-7 and 2.4e-6 in (u, v), where Open CASCADE builds it. A release build does not check, so the census counted these three edges as built; the paranoid census found them (plans/blend-corners step 5), and they fail the same way before that step. The desired result is a checker-green body that matches Open CASCADE's
